description_for_human: Book tours run by verified local operators across Asia: India, Japan, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Bali, the UAE and Nepal.
description_for_model: Search tours by city and keywords or date, get a price for the party size, and open a 24-hour booking hold that the traveller completes by paying on the returned payment_url. Every tour is run by a local operator we contact directly; we confirm the date with the operator and refund in full if they cannot take it. Prices include our margin; do not describe us as the cheapest. Requires an X-Agent-Key header; keys are issued to named agents via info@asiabylocals.com.

auth.instructions: Send the agent key as X-Agent-Key (or Authorization: Bearer). Request one from info@asiabylocals.com.
